jobs.title: Contract Student Worker - Software Engineer (40 hrs/wk)
jobs.description:
**About Zoox**

Zoox is an autonomous ridehailing company building the world's first purpose-built robotaxi — fully electric, bidirectional, with no steering wheel or driver's seat. Backed by Amazon and founded to make transportation safer, cleaner, and more accessible, Zoox designs its vehicles entirely around the rider. We're currently operating in Las Vegas and San Francisco, with Austin and Miami on the horizon, and testing underway across seven U.S. markets.

**About Our Contract Student Worker Program**

Zoox's contract student worker program puts you at the center of one of the most ambitious challenges in transportation. You'll contribute to real projects, work alongside engineers and researchers pushing the boundaries of autonomous technology, and gain experience that goes well beyond the classroom. We're looking for students who bring strong academic foundations, curiosity that doesn't stop at coursework, and a drive to be part of something that matters.

### **Role Overview**

* Build and maintain features for full-stack QA applications (TypeScript frontend/backend, Python for non-frontend services), under the guidance of senior engineers
* Assist in designing and implementing test/integration/end-to-end frameworks and pipeline automation
* Contribute to agent-assisted tooling — e.g., wiring up LLM-based classifiers, structured tool interfaces, or evaluation scripts for existing agentic workflows, with senior engineers owning architecture and safety-critical decisions
* Write and maintain unit/integration tests, fix bugs, and improve the reliability of existing tools
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand test and triage pain points and help build solutions

### **Responsibilities**

* Working with our leads
* Collaborating with our customers
* Software development

### **Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree (completed, or in progress/recently completed) in computer science, engineering, or a related field
* 0-2 years of professional or internship experience in software engineering
* Working proficiency in Python and/or JavaScript/TypeScript
* Familiarity with React (or a similar frontend framework), REST APIs, and Git/version control
* Ability to work independently on well-scoped tasks and ask clarifying questions when requirements are ambiguous
* Strong communication skills and eagerness to learn from senior engineers

### **Bonus Qualifications**

Familiar with React

### **Program Requirements**

* Currently enrolled in a B.S. or M.S. program in a relevant discipline.
* Available to commit to a minimum three-month assignment.
* Able to commit a minimum of 40 hours per week.
* Able to work on-site at one of our office locations.
* Must adhere with Zoox confidentiality requirements, including refraining from using or sharing proprietary company information outside of Zoox, such as in academic research, theses, publications, or presentations.

We want to be transparent: this is not an internship. The Part-Time Student Worker Program is designed to complement your academic experience by providing meaningful, ongoing work alongside your studies. Rather than participating in a cohort-based program, you'll join a team directly and contribute to real projects with real impact. While the program does not include structured intern programming or a pathway to full-time employment, it offers valuable opportunities to learn, develop new skills, and gain hands-on experience in a professional environment.

Compensation for this role is $30/hour.

This is a contract position; employment will be through a vendor contracted with Zoox. The hourly rate is as posted, and benefits eligibility is determined by the vendor.

**About Zoox**

Zoox is developing the first ground-up, fully autonomous vehicle fleet and the supporting ecosystem required to bring this technology to market. Sitting at the intersection of robotics, machine learning, and design, Zoox aims to provide the next generation of mobility-as-a-service in urban environments. We’re looking for top talent that shares our passion and wants to be part of a fast-moving and highly execution-oriented team.

Follow us on LinkedIn

**Accommodations**

If you need an accommodation to participate in the application or interview process please reach out to accommodations@zoox.com or your assigned recruiter.

***A Final Note:***

*You do not need to match every listed expectation to apply for this position. Here at Zoox, we know that diverse perspectives foster the innovation we need to be successful, and we are committed to building a team that encompasses a variety of backgrounds, experiences, and skills.*

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

Apple is revolutionizing artificial intelligence by developing sophisticated foundation models that power intelligent features across our product ecosystem. We're seeking skilled Machine Learning Engineers to transform cutting-edge research into scalable, production-ready AI solutions. We are looking for engineers who are passionate about building systems that push the frontier of deep learning in terms of scaling, efficiency, and flexibility and delight millions of users in Apple products.  
  
We build the foundation models behind intelligent experiences across Apple products, from high-performance server models to highly efficient on-device models, all designed for Apple silicon and for private, personal use. How good these models get depends on the data they learn from and on how well we measure them.  
  
We are looking for a technical leader to drive training data and model evaluation across the foundation model training lifecycle, from pre-training and mid-training through post-training. You will influence our strategy for data development: data at scale, at high quality, compliant with privacy and policy requirements, and targeted through curation and synthesis based on product feedback. You will also drive evaluation that steers model training and predicts real user experience.  
  
**Description**  
  
This position combines machine learning research, model evaluation, and distributed data systems. Success is measured by the model improvements our data produces, and by evaluations that are reliable, predict real user experience, and guide training decisions.  
  
You will work through trade-offs when data, evaluation, and training priorities compete, and bring data and evaluation insights into model decisions: which capabilities to prioritize, which data and mixture changes to adopt, and whether a model is ready for release. You will partner with model training leads, product teams, and security, legal, and compliance teams.  
  
You are a recognized technical expert who leads across teams through technical depth and influence. Depending on your background, the role may include managing a team.  
  
The responsibilities below cover the full scope of the area. Your focus will be the subset that best matches your background, and it can grow over time.  
  

* Production model strategy

  

* Closing the loop between evaluation, data, and training

  

* Evaluation

**About Us**

At Litify, we're powering a new era for the legal industry. Since its founding in 2016, Litify has helped law firms and corporate legal departments turn operations into impact through its leading AI-native Platform of Action.

Over 55K legal professionals and 450+ enterprise clients across plaintiff, insurance defense, immigration, and the Fortune 500 trust Litify to combine cloud-based technology, configurable AI-native workflows, agentic AI, and powerful business analytics into one open ecosystem that moves legal teams from systems of record to systems of action.

Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and recognized as an Inc. 5000 and Deloitte Technology Fast 500 fastest-growing private company, Litify is at the center of legal innovation. Headquartered in New York, we're building the last legal platform our customers will ever need.

**About the Team**  
Lawyers bill in six-minute increments, and every one of them counts. Litify Time & Billing turns that time into revenue: time entry, billing rules and rates, pre-bills and invoices, payments, e-billing, and a two-way sync with Accounting Seed. If you like problems where a rounding rule matters and an invoice has to be right every time, this is your team.

**About the Role**  
Litify is looking for a Software Engineer to join our Time & Billing team. The code you ship decides how firms capture their time, bill their clients, and get paid. We recently integrated with an AI time-capture partner, so the work lawyers do during the day becomes time entries that flow straight into billing. That is the kind of work this team takes on, and on a small team, your part in it is visible.

We want a strong, versatile engineer who works across the stack and is eager to dig into new technologies. Our product runs on Salesforce. Prior Salesforce experience isn't required: if you come from Java, C#, TypeScript, or a similar stack, senior engineers on the team will help you learn the platform.

**AI-assisted development is how this team works.** We use AI coding assistants every day to plan, write, test, and review code. We want someone who already builds this way, knows how to check what the assistant produces, works within solid guardrails, and helps teammates do the same. AI makes each of us faster, but the team still designs, reviews, and decides together.

**How we work:**  
We value speed and follow-through. If you like shipping steadily and seeing your impact in the numbers, you will fit in here.

* We are a team of four engineers, part of a team of nine with an engineering manager, a product manager, a UX designer, and two QA engineers
* We work in two-week agile sprints, where engineers and Product refine the work together and we estimate story points as a team
* We track what we complete each week and look at how AI helps us deliver more
* Features start from Figma designs and go through full QA and a package regression pass before each release
* We ship three major releases a year as Salesforce managed packages, plus patch releases, on a set schedule rather than through continuous deployment
* We keep meetings to a minimum and work through Jira and Slack

**In this role, you will:**
